name: Unconnected pads
description: Advisory (needs a netlist): a component pad that resolves to no net is almost always an error (an unrouted or disconnected pin). Excludes intentional no-net pads (mounting holes, fiducials, test points). Not_applicable without a netlist + placement.
what_it_measures: Count of component pads that resolve to no net (excluding mounting/fiducial/test-point parts).
